purpose: Four rows of T258-official-pop-1500, end to end, before the registered 1,508-call flight: prove the -np 3 serving geometry on this roster, the released system message, the user-turn text part after the audio, sealing and the four registered Audio2Tool scorers on real sealed rows -- including the first tier-8 mixed.wav and the first tier-5 needle wav this roster has ever put on the wire under the official protocol. No smoke number is a task measurement.

T258-official-pop-1500.selection: deterministic and stated before the rows were read off the roster: the roster's lexicographically first sample, plus the LONGEST sample of each of the three tiers. That covers all three strata and the worst request in the flight (tier5_needle:003555, 32.43375 s).

execution_plan_basis.calls: 4 rows x 1 contact = 4 for a clean pass. The plan registers 12 because attempt budget is enforced RUN-CUMULATIVELY: core.model.adapter.FrozenCoreAdapter re-reads every prior attempt's durable actuals for this run id on every request. 12 covers a clean pass plus up to two recoveries; the exposure row's own ceiling is 20.
execution_plan_basis.speech_audio_seconds: 61.3245 s per pass, 183.9735 s across three passes, rounded up to 200; the exposure row's ceiling is 250.

evaluation.what_is_read: transport legality, the rendered prompt shape and its system-message hash (which must be the in-code-default variant, sha256 be7f31a2e8c7e6dd..., 16,143 chars), whether every stratum's audio encodes and returns at all, parse rate and throughput
evaluation.what_is_not_read: no smoke metric is a task measurement and none enters the verdict. The calibration's own smoke is the standing precedent: on four rows it saw zero native tool calls and concluded the model was declining the tools interface, which 400 rows corrected to 87 %.

decision.gate: the cell must complete 4 of 4 contacts, seal a verifiable manifest and score without error before the registered 1,508-call flight is launched
